content: Ma ke pahn keptakai ni ahnsou koaros me emen pahn kapwung ong uhk, ehu rahn ke pahn pwupwudi oh sohla kak pwurehng pwourda.
Kasalehiong ie emen kaun pwungen, I ahpw pahn kasalehiong uhk aramas me nsenamwahu. Kasalehiong ie emen kaun suweden, I ahpw pahn kasalehiong uhk aramas paisuwed.
Ma ke kesempwalki kupwurokong, omw pahpa pahn pohnmwahsohkin uhk. Tiahk en pweipwei kesehla mwahl mwohni ong lih en netiki paliwarail kan.
Ma nanmwarki ketin kupwurohki pwuhng, sapwellime wehi pahn kehlail, ahpw ma e ketin kupwurohkihte mwohni, e pahn kauwehla sapwellime wehi.
Ma ke pahn kapinga mwahl kompoakepahmw, ke pein wiadahr omw lidip.
Aramas suwed kin pein lohdiong nan diparail, nindokon aramas lelepek ar kin nsenamwahu oh saledek.
Aramas mwahu kin dehdehki pwungen me semwehmwe kan, ahpw aramas suwed sohte kak en dehdehki soahng pwukat.
Aramas me sohte kesempwalki meteikan kak kapingada kahnimw ehu. Irail kan me kupwurokong kin kolokol popohl.
Ni ahnsou me aramas kupwurokong men pahn lelki me pweipwei men mwoalen kopwung, me pweipweio pahn kouruhrki oh kapakapailoke sohte tokedi.
Me kin kakerehdi ntahn aramas kin kailongki mehmen me lelepek, ahpw me pwung kan pahn doarehla mour en soangen aramas menet.
Aramas pweipwei kin kasalehda ar lingeringer, ahpw me mie eh lamalam kin kanengamah oh kolokol eh lingeringer.
Ma kaun emen pahn kin rong oh pohnese pakair likamw akan, sapwellime lapalap koaros pahn au likamw.
Aramas paisuwed men oh aramas me kin kahpwalihalao ahneki ire ehute—KAUN-O kin ketin mwasamwasahn ira koaros.
Ma nanmwarki men pahn doarehla pwungen me semwehmwe kan, eh mwehi pahn werei.
Kamakam oh kapwungala seri mehkot mwahu. Ma seri men pahn mweimweiong pein nsene, e pahn kanamenekihala ine.
Ni aramas suwed kan ar kin kaunda wasa, dihp kin laudla. Ahpw me pwung kan pahn momour oh kilang duwen pwupwudien soangen aramas pwukat.
Kaiahn mwahwih noumw pwutak, eri, ke ahpw pahn pohnmwahsohki ahnsou koaros. E sohte pahn kanamenekihiukala.
Wehi ehu me sohte ahneki kaweid en Koht iei wehi ehu me sohte soanamwahu. Meid pai me kin kapwaiada sapwellimen Koht kosonned!
Ke sohte kak kapwungala ladu men ni omw pahn lokaiaiongete. E pahn kak wehwehki omw koasoi, ahpw e sohte pahn kesempwalki.
Mie koapworopworpen aramas pweipwei douluhl men sang mehmen me kin koasoi ni sohte eh lamalam.
Ma ke pahn kihong omw ladu men soahng koaros me e anahne sang ni eh tikitik, ehu rahn e pahn ahnekihla mehkoaros me ke ahneki.
Aramas me kin mwadang en lingeringer kin kalap kahrehda akamai oh pingiping.
Aklapalap pahn kahrehiong omw pahn pwupwudi, ahpw ma ke aktikitik, ke pahn waunla.
Me kin kompoakepahnki lipirap emen kin pein wiahki ih eh imwintihti. E pahn ale lokolok ma e koasoi mehlel nan mwoalen kopwung, oh Koht pahn ketin keriahla ma e sohte lokaia mehlel.
Me keper pwunodki dahme aramas teikan lemeleme duwen kowe, ahpw ma ke pahn likih KAUN-O, ke pahn saledek sang apwal.
Aramas koaros kin anahne kupwuramwahu en kaun emen, ahpw KAUN-O kelepw me kak ketikihong uhk pwuhng.
Me pwung kan kin kailongki me suwed akan, oh me suwed akan kin kailongki me pwung kan.
